reasons: C4-M1 (the only open item in the latest master, cycle-4) is resolved at the root: scripts/mb-team-checkpoint.sh:37-46 now decides ownership by a regular-file marker `.mb-team-checkpoint` (-f and ! -L), an empty dir, or --adopt; any other existing dir inside the tree exits 2 before mkdir/chmod/.gitignore/tar. Name-based matching is gone, so artifact-like names (fix.diff, release.sha256, work.diff/, .secret.untracked, link.diff) no longer grant ownership.

Judge reran the cycle-4 probe (scratchpad/c4r/run2.sh into scratchpad/judgeC/probe1 and probe2): p1 (empty dir) rc 0, mode 700, marker + `*` .gitignore written, tar holds only new.txt; p2-p13 all rc 2 with 'not a dedicated checkpoint dir', listing unchanged, mode 755 kept, user files still in git status. The Python traceback in p3 output comes from the probe's own inspection of the pre-existing empty fake tar, not from the script.

Scoped suites green: bats test_mb_team_checkpoint/cli/hardening 1..43 all ok (rc 0), including new tests 14-19 (artifact-named file/subdir/symlink refused, symlinked marker refused, empty dir adopted, --adopt on populated default dir) and cli test 33 (default dir predating the marker still works). pytest test_mb_team_*.py + test_mb_lock_queue.py: 276 passed.

Ownership path residual check: (a) marker spoofing requires the user to create `.mb-team-checkpoint` themselves, which is an explicit opt-in, not a defect; (b) --adopt is passed by scripts/mb_team_ops.py:124 only when the normalized checkpoint.dir equals <bank>/backups/team, so user config cannot reach it for any other path (an absolute or ../ path that is not the default gets no --adopt); the only residue is a user-made symlink at the default path (J-1, minor, backlog); (c) migration: an existing default dir is adopted (cli test 33); a pre-marker custom dir is refused fail-closed with no writes (J-2, minor, backlog; feature unreleased per AGR-084). No medium or higher remains.

All earlier cycle items are resolved per the cycle 2-4 masters (C1-M1..M7, C2-M1, C2-n1, C2-n2, C3-M1, C3-n1); with C4-M1 now verified, review blockers/majors/mediums remaining = 0. Cycle budget overrun (4 fix cycles vs max 2) is a process note, not a defect: each cycle closed its blocker and the new findings were narrowing regressions of the same guard, now converged.

Stage 11 closure still requires its remaining DoD steps, which are post-judge workflow steps, not review findings: the orchestrator records this verdict as the cycle-4 C4-M1 resolution evidence (latest master.json still shows medium 1 because there was no cycle-5 lead pass), runs plan-verifier, ticks mb-team plan lines 288-289 (45/47 now), and moves 2026-10-10_feature_mb-team.md to plans/done/. Cycle-1 minors/nits go to backlog before done.

Needs the user to symlink backups/team into their own work, so no realistic path; fix: pass --adopt only when os.path.realpath(out) == os.path.realpath(default) and not os.path.islink(out).
